snippet.title: Take That Mainstage! April 2026 Trailer
snippet.description:
It’s 1992 in Emerald City. The world screams for change. Live the creative life and become the next big thing in the ultimate wannabe rockstar life sim! Level up your skills, write & perform music, manage relationships & your band, enter radio contests & compete onstage against your rivals in your quest to achieve your rockstar dreams!

Wishlist! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3309880/Take_That_Mainstage/

Coming Spring 2027. Learn more at: http://www.fingersonthemoon.com
